description: Browse the ~85 nonfuel mineral commodities covered by the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (MCS) annual data release — lithium, copper, cobalt, rare earths, gold, aluminum, nickel, platinum-group metals, and dozens more, through industrial minerals like barite and feldspar. Each entry names its U.S. statistics columns (production, imports, exports, price, employment, net import reliance — varies by commodity) and whether a world production/reserves-by-country table is also available (mcs_country_comparison). Optional substring query over commodity name or code. Keyless.

limit.description: Max commodities to return, default 100, max 200.

query.description: Optional substring filter over commodity name or code, e.g. "earth" or "iron".

name: mcs_list_commodities
title: Mcs List Commodities
